pkgmetadata.longdescription: Scripts from the AdobeWine project that create a per-user Wine prefix for Adobe Creative Cloud apps (DXVK, vkd3d-proton with a D3D12 shim, fonts, registry tweaks) and launch Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro and friends with app-emulation/wine-adobe. Gentoo installs DXVK, vkd3d-proton, wine-gecko and wine-mono itself, so nothing is downloaded at run time except the Microsoft redistributables winetricks fetches.
